notes.summary: ChatLocale gained required keys in 0.17.3. A hand-written full ChatLocale object no longer compiles and misses texts until it has them. Partial<ChatLocale> overrides are unaffected.
notes.howTo: Add these keys to every full ChatLocale object: activityExpectedLabel. English and German defaults ship with the SDK; the locale prop of AiChatProvider takes Partial<ChatLocale>, so partial overrides need no change.

notes.summary: ActivityStepStatus gained 'expected'. A failure output (success: false or an error text) is no longer 'done': it is 'expected' (neutral) or 'error'. An exhaustive switch or Record over the type no longer compiles.
notes.howTo: Add a case for 'expected' to every exhaustive switch or Record<ActivityStepStatus, ...>: show it neutrally, never as failed. A step is 'expected' when the output has success: false and either expectedFailure: true (any status) or an integer status from 400 to 499 other than 408 and 429, unless the SDK's endpoint caller refused the path itself (Endpoint path is not allowed / must be relative). Every other failure output (5xx, 408, 429, no status, an error text without success: false) is 'error'. Tests that assert activity-log summary text or the check icon for failed outputs need updating. Display only: maxConsecutiveErrors and metrics still follow classifyToolFailure.

notes.summary: UI tools no longer tell the model 'Action executed.': the message says the action was handed to the app and its outcome is unknown. The default chat no longer shows a result block for UI tools.
notes.howTo: A custom ToolResultBlock or onToolResult that renders message of UI tools now shows this model-facing note to users: skip message for UI tools or declare your own successMessage on defineUiTool. Tests that expect 'Action executed.' need updating.

notes.summary: glirastes tools refresh now reads the tsconfig.json nearest to each source's scanned folder. In a monorepo, contracts imported through app-level path aliases resolve, so tools can become enabled and tools check reports drift.
notes.howTo: Run glirastes tools refresh, review the diff (previously disabled tools may be enabled, contracts typed) and commit it. Name a specific file with the new tsconfig option on a source in .glirastes/tools.json. The finding ui-action-import-unresolved names an import that still cannot be resolved.
